display_long_description:
Step into the darkness of Dreadwood Forest, where an abandoned containment site hides more than just shadows. What began as a secret experiment has spiraled into a nightmare that no fence, no wall, and no soldier could ever stop. In Outbreak Dreadwood, you are trapped in a sprawling facility that leads into a forest shrouded in fog, hunted by horrors that thrive in the silence. Every creak of a branch, every whisper of the wind could be your last warning before they find you. 

Immersive VR Survival Horror – Experience fear like never before with full 360° immersion. 

Dynamic Exploration – Navigate abandoned outposts, blood-soaked trails, and hidden underground facilities. Unrelenting Tension – Limited resources force you to make every bullet, every step, every breath count. 

Early Access Terror – Get in first, survive the outbreak, and shape the future of the game with your feedback. The outbreak was never contained. It was only delayed. 

Are you ready to step into the woods… and never walk out?
